```cpp
template<auto, auto = [] {}>
bool flag = true;

template<typename>
struct core {
  template<typename>
  auto func() -> bool {
    return flag<0>;
  }
};

auto main() -> int {
  core<int> _;
  [[maybe_unused]] bool flag = _.func<int>();
}
```
